description.it: Più agenti di coding da CLI (Claude Code, Codex) in parallelo, ognuno sul suo worktree git: leggi il diff, commenta gli hunk, rimanda la review all'agente e apri la pull request.
description.en: Several CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) in parallel, each on its own git worktree: read the diff, comment on hunks, send the review back to the agent and open the pull request.
